description: A wicker basket of fruit sits on the table, with a plate to the right holding a long loaf and a couple of smaller items. The right hand reaches in from the right toward the loaf on the plate, grips it as a right-hand object, lifts it up and carries it left over the basket, then lowers and releases it into the basket; the right hand then returns to the plate, pinches a small piece as a right-hand object, lifts it, and places it into the basket near the other fruit before letting go.
